plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'American Sign Language map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program has TWO pathways; this plan transcribes the first/default 'to Degree' pathway in full. The second pathway, 'to CSU' (printed at 60-62.5 units, 4 terms), is a second GE pattern for the same credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and term totals as 14-15.5 / 14 / 16 / 16. The only ranged row is Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. This to-Degree map uses Bakersfield College local GE areas marked '(BC)', transcribed exactly as printed. ASL B1 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; it is a named major course and is recorded with category 'major'. ASL B2, ASL B3 and ASL B4 each show a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flags are disclosed on those course rows. No other row shows a 'Prerequisites' flag. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
